@graph.name: County kicks off Countywide Strategic Plan process
@graph.description: The County launched a year-long process to set shared housing, climate, and digital government goals.

@graph.name: Board approves dedicated Housing Trust Fund revenue source
@graph.description: The Board of Supervisors voted to dedicate an ongoing revenue source to capitalize the County's Housing Trust Fund.

@graph.name: Housing Trust Fund on track to reach initial capitalization by year-end
@graph.description: The Housing Trust Fund's first funding round is 70% capitalized, on pace to close by December 2026.

@graph.name: Public meeting scheduled to review implementation progress
@graph.description: A public meeting on October 14, 2026 will review progress across all four strategic goals and gather input on next steps.
